name: Los Olivos District
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Los Olivos District is moderately warm, a cool Winkler Region III, with little fog.
Most vines are Bordeaux and Rhône grapes, and Italian and Spanish grapes are common too.

blurb.text: A Santa Ynez Valley AVA in Santa Barbara County, on a broad alluvial terrace plain of the Santa Ynez River, taking in Los Olivos, Ballard, Santa Ynez and Solvang.
